root.label: Burnham changes early release scheme and promises IPP legislation

events.label: Burnham changes early release scheme and promises IPP legislation

slots.name: killers prison status
slots.sentence: PC Andrew Harper’s killers will remain behind bars after Andy Burnham announced changes to the early release scheme aimed at easing prison overcrowding

slots.name: unlawful killing exclusion
slots.sentence: The prime minister said anyone convicted of unlawful killing, including all forms of manslaughter, would be excluded from the scheme

slots.name: eligible killers count
slots.sentence: which would have made two of the officer’s killers eligible for early release

slots.name: custody sentence length
slots.sentence: The police officer was 28 when he sustained fatal injuries while responding to a quad bike theft in Sulhamstead, Berkshire in August 2019.

slots.name: prison occupancy rate
slots.sentence: Burnham admitted the change in the government’s controversial plans would mean “hundreds” more people stay in prison

slots.name: IPP population
slots.sentence: According to Ministry of Justice data, 2,271 people are serving IPP sentences as of June.

slots.name: IPP release denials
slots.sentence: Of those, 856 have not been released because the Parole Board thought it was not safe to do so.

slots.name: IPP people behind bars
slots.sentence: The prime minister said that in this parliament he would end detainment under imprisonment for public protection sentences, or IPPs, which were abolished more than a decade ago but still keep more than 2,000 people in England and Wales behind bars.
